newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa industrials, all-shares at new highs.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa industrials, all-shares at new highs.

text.p: The South African industrial and all-share indices finished at record closing highs in active trade on Thursday, boosted by a host of positive news.

Dealers said that two upbeat sets of economic data, namely the far higher-than-expected May trade surplus of 1.75 billion rand released earlier and Wednesday's lower-than-forecast May consumer inflation figure, had cheered the market.
The announcement that private individuals may invest 200,000 rand offshore from July 1, well above the 160,000 limit anticipated by the market, had also boosted sentiment.

A rally on the futures market helped to propel industrial stocks, aiding the industrial index to a record finish of 8,742.3, a gain of 72.4 points surpassing the previous high seen on January 25, 1996 when the index was at 8,752.9 points.
The jovial mood held gold shares steady despite a slightly weaker bullion price. The index gained 1.4 points 1,008.8.
The all-share index was pushed up 48.7 points to its third consecutive closing high of 7,402.7.
